segments.name: Pharmaceuticals
segments.description: Researches, develops and commercializes neuroscience treatments for neurological, psychiatric, endocrine and immunological disorders, selling mainly in the U.S.
segments.evidence: Neurocrine Biosciences operates as a single global business segment dedicated to the research and development, commercialization, and sale of pharmaceuticals primarily in the U.S. for the treatment of under-addressed neurological, psychiatric, endocrine, and immunological disorders.

revenueModel.text: Specialty pharmacy providers, wholesale distributors and specialty distributors pay for INGREZZA and CRENESSITY, and the company earns royalties on partner sales.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers include select specialty pharmacy providers, wholesale distributors, and specialty distributors.

changes.text: In 2026, Neurocrine completed the sale of Neurocrine Group Limited to Immedica Pharma AB.
changes.evidence: on January 21, 2026, we completed the sale of Neurocrine Group Limited to Immedica Pharma AB
